headline: Bank Lending: Credit Expansion Above €16 Billion in 2026 – 15-Year Record | News
summary: Credit expansion in Greece in 2026 is expected to reach at least €16 billion, pointing to a new record of at least 15 years as bank loans grow.
why: Bank lending growth signals household and corporate demand for credit and influences economic activity. It is closely watched by the Bank of Greece and investors in Greek banks.
